name: Groundnut Oil
shortDescription: Fresh and pure groundnut oil suitable for daily cooking.
description: Traditionally processed groundnut oil with rich aroma and natural taste. Our groundnut oil is cold-pressed using traditional methods to retain all the natural goodness. Free from additives and preservatives.

name: Sesame Oil
shortDescription: Pure sesame oil with traditional aroma and natural goodness.
description: Our sesame oil is extracted using traditional wooden press (ghani) method to preserve natural aroma and nutritional value. Rich in antioxidants and perfect for South Indian cooking.

name: Coconut Oil
shortDescription: Pure coconut oil for cooking and hair care.
description: Cold-pressed pure coconut oil, ideal for cooking, hair care, and skin care. Made from fresh coconuts with no chemicals or additives. Solidifies naturally in cool temperatures, which is a sign of purity.

name: Mustard Oil
shortDescription: Pure mustard oil with strong aroma for pickles and cooking.
description: Kachi Ghani mustard oil with strong, pungent aroma. Perfect for pickles, North Indian cooking, and traditional recipes. Made from quality mustard seeds using traditional pressing methods.

name: Castor Oil
shortDescription: Natural castor oil for hair growth and skin care.
description: Pure castor oil cold-pressed from quality castor seeds. Known for its thick consistency and immense benefits for hair growth, skin, and traditional medicinal use.

name: Sunflower Oil
shortDescription: Light and healthy sunflower oil for everyday cooking.
description: Premium quality sunflower oil with light texture and neutral flavor. Low in saturated fats and ideal for daily cooking, baking, and frying.

name: Rice Bran Oil
shortDescription: Healthy rice bran oil with high smoke point.
description: Premium rice bran oil extracted from the outer layer of rice. High smoke point makes it ideal for high-temperature cooking. Rich in Vitamin E and antioxidants.

name: Foxtail Millet
shortDescription: Nutritious foxtail millet for healthy cooking.
description: Organic foxtail millet (Korralu) rich in fiber and protein. Ideal for rice substitute, khichdi, and traditional recipes. A healthy grain for diabetic-friendly diets.

name: Little Millet
shortDescription: Little millet - a wholesome grain for healthy meals.
description: Little millet (Samalu) is a nutritious whole grain packed with minerals and fiber. Great for weight management and daily healthy eating.

name: Kodo Millet
shortDescription: Kodo millet - a traditional and nutritious grain.
description: Kodo millet (Arikelu) is an ancient grain with excellent nutritional profile. Low glycemic index makes it ideal for diabetics and health-conscious individuals.

name: Barnyard Millet
shortDescription: Barnyard millet - fast cooking and highly nutritious.
description: Barnyard millet (Udalu) is one of the fastest cooking millets with high nutritional value. Perfect substitute for rice and ideal for fasting days.

name: Pearl Millet
shortDescription: Pearl millet (Bajra) for roti and traditional dishes.
description: Pearl millet (Bajra/Sajjalu) is a powerhouse grain rich in iron and protein. Makes excellent rotis and traditional Rajasthani and South Indian dishes.

name: Finger Millet
shortDescription: Ragi (Finger Millet) - rich in calcium and minerals.
description: Finger millet (Ragi/Ragulu) is an exceptional source of calcium, making it ideal for growing children and adults. Rich in amino acids and minerals.

name: Murukulu
shortDescription: Crispy and crunchy traditional murukulu snack.
description: Freshly made crispy murukulu prepared with rice flour and urad dal. Made in groundnut oil for authentic taste. A classic South Indian snack loved by all ages.

name: Chekkalu
shortDescription: Traditional rice crackers - crispy Chekkalu.
description: Crispy Chekkalu (rice crackers) made with rice flour, sesame seeds, and spices. Fried in pure groundnut oil for authentic taste and crunch.

name: Mixture
shortDescription: Spicy and flavorful traditional mixture snack.
description: A classic South Indian mixture with a perfect blend of sev, peanuts, flattened rice, and spices. Made fresh in pure groundnut oil.

name: Karam Boondi
shortDescription: Spicy boondi snack made with gram flour.
description: Crispy and spicy boondi made from gram flour (besan) with traditional spices. Perfect for adding to curd rice or eating as a standalone snack.

name: Millet Snacks
shortDescription: Healthy and tasty snacks made from millets.
description: Nutritious snacks made from a blend of millets including ragi, jowar, and bajra. A healthy alternative to regular snacks without compromising on taste.

name: Bellam Laddu
shortDescription: Traditional jaggery laddus with rich taste.
description: Handmade bellam (jaggery) laddus prepared with traditional recipe. Made with pure jaggery, besan, and ghee. A classic sweet with natural sweetness.

name: Sesame Laddu
shortDescription: Nutritious sesame laddus with jaggery.
description: Nuvvula (sesame) laddu made with roasted sesame seeds and jaggery. Rich in calcium and iron. A traditional energy-boosting sweet.

name: Groundnut Chikki
shortDescription: Crunchy peanut chikki made with pure jaggery.
description: Palli (groundnut) chikki made with roasted groundnuts and pure sugarcane jaggery. Hard and crunchy texture with natural sweetness. A timeless classic snack-sweet.

name: Dry Fruit Laddu
shortDescription: Premium dry fruit laddus with nuts and dates.
description: Luxurious dry fruit laddus packed with cashews, almonds, pistachios, dates, and figs. Bound with pure honey or jaggery. Perfect for gifting and special occasions.

name: Mango Pickle
shortDescription: Spicy and tangy traditional mango pickle.
description: Traditional Andhra-style raw mango pickle made with pure sesame oil and fresh spices. The authentic family recipe that captures the true taste of homemade pickles.

name: Gongura Pickle
shortDescription: Authentic Andhra Gongura pickle with pure oil.
description: Signature Andhra Gongura (sorrel leaves) pickle made with pure sesame oil. The pride of Andhra cuisine, this tangy and spicy pickle is a must-try. Made fresh with quality ingredients.

name: Tomato Pickle
shortDescription: Tangy homestyle tomato pickle.
description: Freshly made tomato pickle with ripe tomatoes, aromatic spices, and pure oil. A tangy and slightly sweet pickle that goes well with rice, roti, and tiffins.

name: Lemon Pickle
shortDescription: Classic lemon pickle with aromatic spices.
description: Traditional lemon pickle made with fresh lemons, turmeric, and aromatic spices. A digestive-friendly pickle with the right balance of sour and spice.

name: Idli Karam
shortDescription: Spicy and flavorful idli powder for breakfast.
description: Traditional Andhra-style idli karam (gun powder) made with lentils, dry red chilies, and sesame seeds. Mix with sesame oil or groundnut oil and enjoy with idli or dosa.

name: Curry Leaf Powder
shortDescription: Nutritious curry leaf powder for rice and tiffin.
description: Freshly made curry leaf (Karivepaku) powder packed with natural flavor and nutrients. An excellent rice mix or tiffin side dish with pure oil.

name: Groundnut Powder
shortDescription: Freshly roasted groundnut powder for cooking.
description: Freshly roasted groundnut (peanut) powder, perfect for making chutneys, adding to gravies, or using as a rice mix. Rich in protein and flavor.

name: Sesame Powder
shortDescription: Nutritious sesame powder for various uses.
description: Freshly roasted sesame seed powder rich in calcium and nutrients. Used in chutneys, rice mixes, and sweet preparations like til laddu.

name: Jaggery
shortDescription: Pure sugarcane jaggery - natural sweetener.
description: Pure sugarcane jaggery (Bellam) from trusted sources. A natural sweetener rich in iron and minerals, free from chemicals and artificial colors. Dark golden color indicates purity.

name: Honey
shortDescription: Pure natural honey from trusted sources.
description: Natural raw honey sourced from trusted beekeepers. Unfiltered and unprocessed to retain natural enzymes, antioxidants, and nutrients. Rich golden color with natural crystallization.

name: Ghee
shortDescription: Pure desi ghee with traditional aroma.
description: Pure desi cow ghee made using traditional bilona method. Rich golden color with authentic aroma. Made from cultured butter for maximum purity and nutritional value.

name: Dry Fruits Mix
shortDescription: Premium dry fruits mix for health and gifting.
description: A premium mix of cashews, almonds, raisins, pistachios, and figs. Sourced from quality suppliers. Perfect for daily health routine, gifting, and festive occasions.
